    Vennerian Trade Republic

    Colonies & Holdings¶

    Vennerian influence spans continents through a vast network:

    Holding Location Type
    Vennerian Goishi Lumina Continent Major commercial outpost with cities
    Vennerian Aelefer Channel Lumina Continent Strategic channel
    Vennerian Channel (Marti) Marti Continent Strategic channel
    New Eris Lumina Continent Large colonial territory
    Vennerian Pride Tuba Colonial outpost
    Love of the Sea Kutten Trading outpost
    Mia Checkpoint Mia island Checkpoint
    New Venner Dissenbarg Peninsula colony
    Johannstadt Dissenbarg Large land territory — former Taberis, taken illegally in 524 AGD
    Sua Dissenbarg Island colony — Venner's original Dissenbarg foothold, before the Taberis takeover
    Eribel Dissenbarg Island outpost
    Neopao Minir island Conquered territory
    Koln Minir island Conquered territory
    Aelefer South Erisdar Land territory
    Melior South Erisdar Coastal city
    Media Luminous Ocean Island controlled by Venner
    Erima Archipelago (partial) Luminous Ocean Shared with Erima

    In 544 AGD, Venner invaded Minir island, conquering Neopao (northeast) and Koln (southeast). Dukedam was reduced to a forced puppet state. Mikrad and Gomor resent Venner for this and maintain hostile relations.

    Puppet States & Influence¶

    • Germina (Marti Continent) — effectively a Vennerian puppet. Settled by Erisdarian humans and Erisdarian Catmen who arrived on Vennerian ships.
    • Dukedam (Minir) — forced puppet since the 544 AGD invasion.
    • Lumina Kingdom — significant Vennerian influence, anchored by Vennerian Goishi.
    • New Elvengar (Kutten) — sustains itself through a partnership with Venner.

    Foreign Relations¶

    Rivals¶

    • Anos Plutocracy — Venner's primary rival. Anos is weaker but still formidable, controlling fewer territories but maintaining a powerful fleet. The two are locked in a permanent naval and trade race.
    • Mikrad and Gomor — hostile toward Venner since the Minir invasion.

    Allies¶

    • Corinite League — long-term ally. Venner is slowly integrating the League and is expected to formally annex it within the next several years. This would make Venner the undisputed dominant power in Dissenbarg. Beyond the League, Venner is slowly taking over Dissenbarg's politics, turning its states into tributaries and vassals — a patient process that will take years to complete.
    • Grimmel Republic — strong trade partnership and good relations.

    Neutral/Balancing¶

    • Limese League — works with both Venner and Anos, balancing the two powers for profit.

    Trade & Culture¶

    Venner deals in everything. Spices, metals, Romanium, timber, textiles — and slaves. The Vennerian slave trade is substantial, with a particular appetite for beastmen slaves from Lumina Continent.

    Vennerian culture has spread globally through their trade networks. Their language, Vennerian, is the lingua franca of international commerce.

    The Catmen Obsession¶

    The Vennerian aristocracy is famously — and somewhat notoriously — obsessed with Catmen, especially catgirls. Human-cat hybrids exist in Vennerian high society, despite the Erisian church formally forbidding human-catmen marriages. This prohibition is widely ignored.

    Across all of Ge'or — including within the Erisian Empire and even the Erisian church — catmen are viewed amicably. They are the one species nobody hates.

    Power Ranking¶

    Venner is considered an SS-tier power — alongside the Asatru Empire, Erisian Empire, Northaxeland, Kramsadar (isolated), Alborric (isolated), and the Central Kingdom (Tabontabar).

    It is widely expected that Venner will eventually surpass the Erisian Empire as the dominant power on Ge'or.
